messages:
alan_sec: quick flag from the quarterly least-priv sweep: we still have ~120 role bindings granting kms:Decrypt across staging and prod to a handful of long-lived svcaccts. wondering if we should fold KMS usage signals into the access review flow.

marta-ops: agree. KMS logs give better signal than last-login. but need noise filtering (CI churn) and a way to map service keys back to product owners.

jen-audit: +1. our reviewers keep hitting envelope keys and getting stuck. we need a rubric: when does GenerateDataKey==active use? how to treat delegated cross-account grants?

alan_sec: propose: consider a key "active" if it has any Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls in the past 30 days AND matches an ownership mapping, else surface for manual review. add a separate exception path for short-lived CI roles.

leo-sre: practical note: we have case where a platform svcacct rotates keys frequently via cross-account assume-role. that looks noisy but is legitimate. we could tag those svcaccts with platform=true and auto-exempt if provenance shows assumers from trusted accounts.

marta-ops: implementation plan: 1) log-processor adds metadata tag recert_evidence=true when rule matched; 2) recert pipeline consumes tag rather than scanning raw logs; 3) reviewer UI shows provenance and linked storage objects.

infra-bot: FYI: log-processor job schedule: every 4h. Last run 2026-03-20T08:00:12Z.

jen-audit: what about envelope-only keys? They appear as GenerateDataKey but never Encrypt/Decrypt. We should count GenerateDataKey as valid evidence if we can link to an S3 object or DB column that used the data key.

alan_sec: yep. add correlation step: join KMS events with storage access logs by data_key_id -> object_id. if correlation exists within 30d, count active.

leo-sre: cost/scale concern: cross-joining logs could be heavy. limit correlation to keys that are below threshold (candidate for removal) to avoid full joins.

marta-ops: I'll prototype a tagger rule. pseudocode: MATCH event.type IN (Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey) WHERE event.ts > now()-30d GROUP BY key_id HAVING count(*) > 0 AND ((sum(bytes)/total_bytes) > 0.03 OR count(*) > 20) => tag key_id with recert_evidence=true

alan_sec: action items: marta to prototype tagging job (ETA Mon), jen to update reviewer guidance and exception criteria (ETA Thu), leo to provide list of trusted platform accounts for auto-exempt mapping (ETA Tue).

jen-audit: also add reviewer checklist: if key is envelope-only, require storage-object correlation or a documented design note from owner. if cross-account grants exist, confirm the trust boundary and rotation cadence.

infra-bot: Created ticket SEC-1542: "KMS recert evidence tagging + reviewer runbook updates" assigned to marta-ops, jen-audit (due 2026-03-24).

marta-ops: noted, will include redaction step so logs sent to recert index remove any PII.

alan_sec: thanks. we'll run pilot on 200 lowest-usage keys after tagging to validate false positives before full rollout.

leo-sre: +1. keep me posted if we need sample traces for platform svcaccts.

jen-audit: acked.

alan_sec: closing thread for now, thanks team :thumbsup:
